listening_script.speed_note: Read aloud at a normal, clear pace (85 wpm). Pause 2–3 seconds between sentences. Read the full text twice before students answer questions.
listening_script.text:
ENERGY is the ability to do work or cause change.
Energy cannot be created or destroyed - only changed!
TYPES OF ENERGY:
1. KINETIC ENERGY - Energy of movement
- A moving car, running person, flowing water
2. POTENTIAL ENERGY - Stored energy
- A ball at the top of a hill, stretched rubber band
3. HEAT ENERGY (Thermal)
- Energy from hot things
- Sun, fire, your body
4. LIGHT ENERGY
- Energy we can see
- Sun, light bulbs, screens
5. SOUND ENERGY
- Energy we can hear
- Music, voices, thunder
6. ELECTRICAL ENERGY
- Energy from electrons moving
- Powers our devices
ENERGY TRANSFORMATIONS:
- Sun (light) → Plants (chemical) → You (kinetic/heat)
- Electricity → Light bulb → Light + Heat
- Food (chemical) → Your body (kinetic + heat)
Energy is always changing from one form to another!
dictation: ENERGY is the ability to do work or cause change.
Energy cannot be created or destroyed - only changed!
